message: SABDHAM 1.2.4 is available with a richer Home top bar background and a slightly larger logo. This update is optional.
releaseNotes: Richer dark-green Home top bar background with soft depth and glow.
Slightly larger SABDHAM logo for better visibility.
Optional updates are surfaced through SABDHAM notifications in supported versions.
Major required updates continue to use the non-dismissible update screen.
